messages.author: Kenneth Huang
messages.body:
Hi all,
Hopefully a simple question, but is the EZAFF forcefield (
https://pubs.acs.org/doi/abs/10.1021/acs.jctc.7b00773
) bundled somewhere in
Amber? I’ve dug around but all I could find is the test case for mcpby?
Best,
Kenneth
-- 
Ask yourselves, all of you, what power would hell have if those imprisoned
here could not dream of heaven?
